artworks.title: Poverty (Armut)
artworks.description: The image shows a person depicted in a stylized manner. The person is seated on the ground with one knee raised, an arm draped over it, and the other hand resting on the surface. The person's face is angular with distinct lines, large expressive eyes, and sharp features painted in bold colors. Their hair appears to be dark and closely cropped. The clothing consists of a blue garment with red accents, possibly a jacket or coat, and brown trousers. The feet are exposed. The background is abstract, featuring geometric shapes in various colors suggestive of a cityscape or landscape, with blocks of black, green, and purple adding depth and complexity to the scene. There is a signature "A. Walth" and the year "1919" noted at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Mars
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in sepia-ochre, olive and black
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright with legs slightly apart and leaning on a staff held in their right hand. The person wears a helmet with feathers or foliage, short hair under the helmet, and a muscular upper body with a draped garment over one shoulder. The background is plain with minimal decoration and a small plant near the person's feet. In the top left, there is a circular depiction of an animal, possibly a bear, on all fours.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child with Saint Anne by a Portal
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 23 x 15.5 cm (9 1/16 x 6 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts an elaborate interior scene with intricate architectural details and figures. It features a vaulted ceiling adorned with arches and a carving of a dove at the center. Two figures are seated on either side, with a playful toddler-like figure reaching up between them. In the background, there is a colonnade and figures peering through windows. The drawing suggests a narrative or thematic element with symbolic references.

artworks.title: Saint Andrew
artworks.medium: red chalk with brown and gray wash heightened withwhite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length depiction of a person in a standing position. The figure's head is slightly bowed, with their eyes cast downward. The person has an aged appearance, characterized by a long beard and possibly balding hair, both depicted in the same reddish-brown hue as the rest of the artwork. The person is draped in loose, flowing robes that cover their entire body. They are holding an object that resembles a closed book or scroll in their right hand. The background is a lightly shaded brown. There is a dark border that frames the entire image.

artworks.title: Apollo
artworks.description: This drawing shows a man standing with his weight shifted onto one leg. His right arm is raised above his head, and faint lines seem to indicate that he is holding something, but the object is indistinct. His left arm is out by his side, holding a draped cloth that is tied across his chest and billows behind him. Other than that cloth, the man is nude. His facial features are faint, showing only a pointed nose, dark eyes, thin lips in a neutral expression, and short hair styled close to his head. The drawing is made of red lines, and the background is plain beige paper, which appears to have some faint stains and areas of gray discoloration.

artworks.title: Mary Magdalene [recto]
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink with brown wash heightened in white over black chalk
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a woman standing elegantly with her body slightly turned to the side. She has delicate facial features, a serene expression, and styled hair. She wears a flowing robe and holds a small vessel in one hand. The background includes a cherub-like figure and swirling patterns. The drawing is done in sepia tones, giving it an aged look.

artworks.title: Mary Magdalene [verso]
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink with brown wash heightened in white over black chalk
artworks.description: The image shows a standing woman turned slightly to her right, looking down. She has delicate facial features and long hair. She is wearing flowing robes and holds a vessel on a pedestal. In the background, there is a hint of a natural environment and another figure seated near shrubs. The artwork is done in a brown wash, emphasizing textures and shading.

artworks.title: Saint John the Baptist
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a figure from the waist up. The person is slightly turned to the viewer's left, with one hand on their chest and the other holding a long, slender object resembling a rod with a cross on top. The facial features are delicately rendered with prominent eyes, a slightly open mouth, and soft, curly hair framing the face and neck. The figure appears to be male, unclothed, displaying a well-defined torso and muscular arms. There is no jewelry present. The background is plain, with some subtle texture and small patches of discoloration on the paper, giving the image a historic and naturalistic feel.

artworks.title: View of a Dutch Town (Delft?)
artworks.artist: Willem van de Velde the Younger
artworks.medium: graphite and gray wash on laid paper, incised with stylus
artworks.description: The image shows a distant point of view of a cityscape along a horizontal line. The horizon is positioned at about one-third from the bottom of the image, with the skyline of a distant town dominated by church towers. A solitary sailboat is depicted nearby, on calm water. The painting features loose and impressionistic brushstrokes with light lines and gray shading, conveying the scene with minimal detail. The color palette is muted, with soft beige and gray tones creating a serene visual impact.

artworks.title: Paris Awarding the Apple to Venus
artworks.description: The image shows three figures, each with different poses and varying degrees of visibility. The central figure on the left is kneeling with muscular form and partially draped in cloth. The figure faces another figure above. The top figure appears young with wings and one hand extended. On the right, a standing figure holds a garment with soft facial features. The background is plain with sketch lines suggesting an ethereal setting.

artworks.title: Supper at Emmaus
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 10.5 x 13.8 cm (4 1/8 x 5 7/16 in.)
support: 20.3 x 33.7 cm (8 x 13 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals seated around a table inside a tent. The central figure is engaging with the other two individuals. One person is seated to the left, with their body turned towards the others, while another person is seen from behind to the right. All three are wearing robes, and there is a loaf of bread on the table in front of them.

artworks.title: The Madonna and Child Enthroned with Saint John the Baptist and Saint Andrew
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black  chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The drawing shows four people. Near the top left corner, a woman in a long dress is seated, holding a nude child on her lap. Her seat is at the top of several steps. Near the bottom left corner, a bearded man in a toga kneels at the bottom of the steps, looking over his shoulder towards us, holding a thin staff with what looks like a ribbon wrapping around the top. On the right, another man in a robe stands at the base of the stairs, holding a tall cross and looking up towards the seated woman. The background features architectural elements including columns and a paneled wall. The drawing is done in sepia ink on beige paper.

artworks.title: Standing Shepherd in a Landscape
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a wooded setting, facing slightly towards the right. He is holding a long staff in one hand, with his other arm raised near his chest. The man has a prominent beard and bushy, unkempt hair. He is minimally clothed with a draped cloth around his waist. The environment includes trees with thick trunks and leafy branches, suggesting a forest. The background contains large rocks and foliage, creating a natural outdoor setting. The drawing is monochrome with a red chalk technique, giving it an antique look.

artworks.title: Academic Nude Study of a Seated Male
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure sketched in red chalk. The man is seated with his left leg bent and his right leg stretched out in front of him. His torso is turned slightly to the side, and his head is bowed down, offering a profile view. He has prominent facial features with a well-defined nose and a dense, curly beard. His hair is curly and slightly tousled. The man is nude, and the drawing emphasizes the muscular detail of his physique. He is seated on a draped cloth, with his left hand resting on a rolled-up section of the fabric. The background has a textured appearance, likely representing a fabric or surface, achieved with fine hatching and shading techniques.

artworks.title: Landscape Study
artworks.medium: brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a view looking up through a cluster of trees with branches and foliage reaching skyward. The brushstrokes are swift and loose, conveying movement and form to the trees and leaves. The color palette is primarily different shades of brown, creating an earthy and monochromatic appearance. In the background, wispy clouds are suggested with light strokes against the pale surface of the page.

artworks.title: Kneeling Woman Lifting Her Hand to Her Head
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person in a kneeling position. They are facing left in profile, with their hands clasped in front of their chin. The person has short hair and is wearing a long, flowing garment. The background is simple and the drawing is framed.

artworks.title: Standing Bearded Man Pointing Toward the Left
artworks.description: The image depicts a person from the knees up in a dynamic posture. The figure is shown with their upper body slightly turned, right arm outstretched to the front. The facial features are subtly suggested, with an outline of a prominent nose, beard extending below the chin, and wavy, receding hair flowing into the beard. The person is dressed in long, flowing robes with folds indicating layers and movement. There are no visible jewelry or objects held by the figure. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Battle with the Cutlass
artworks.artist: Agostino dei Musi, after Giulio Romano
artworks.description: The image shows a battle scene with warriors on horseback, men with weapons, and fallen individuals on rocky terrain. Horses and horsemen are prominent, with flowing capes and elaborate helmets. There are burning structures in the background. The clouds and landscape enhance the mood, while detailed etching lines provide texture, depicting motion and strife.

artworks.title: Study for One of Two Stained Glass Paintings Representing the Nativity
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash over black chalk
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elderly man tending to two oxen. The man is holding a stick or tool, gesturing forward with his other hand. He is positioned beside the oxen in a stable-like setting, with a stone archway and slatted roof visible. Above the scene, ornamental designs of acanthus leaves, a bird, berries, and leaves are depicted. The drawing features detailed lines and shading to create depth and capture a serene moment.

artworks.title: Classical Landscape
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 24.4 x 36 cm (9 5/8 x 14 3/16 in.)
support: 35.3 x 47.2 cm (13 7/8 x 18 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with gently rolling hills in the distance, trees and foliage with varied textures in the foreground, and a high horizon intersecting the tops of the hills. The drawing is done with soft brushstrokes using an earthy color palette and red chalk lines for warmth. The sky blends into the landscape, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Studies of Major von Washington
artworks.medium: graphite and watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows three sketches of a man. The first two sketches on the left display the man in profile and rear view, wearing a military coat and a bicorne hat. The third sketch on the right shows a detailed profile view of the man's face, showcasing his adorned hat and determined facial features. The man wears a uniform coat with a high red collar and double buttons. There are additional military details like a sash or gloves. The background of the sketches is plain with some signs of age, such as a small red paper fragment and light stains.

artworks.title: The Descent from the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a religious scene. The composition features a large cross with figures removing a body from it using tools like ladders. Other crosses and figures in mourning or action are shown in the foreground. The background shows a detailed landscape with architectural structures. The drawing is detailed, with finely rendered figures and drapery, creating a historical atmosphere.

artworks.title: An Allegorical Figure: Non sine labore
artworks.description: The image shows a cherubic figure in a suspended position amidst swirling clouds. The cherub has curly hair, a round face, and a serene expression. It is portrayed in classical art style without clothing, draped in flowing fabric. The cherub holds a leafy branch overhead. The background includes detailed clouds and fabric to imply motion and wind. Below the scene is a cartouche with scrollwork, a bearded face, and the words "NON SINE LABORE" inscribed. The artwork is an engraving with detailed line work and classical design elements.

artworks.title: An Allegorical Figure: Virtutis Praemium
artworks.description: The image features a winged figure descending from the sky, surrounded by clouds. The figure faces forward with one arm raised and the other holding a trumpet-like instrument against his chest. The figure has curly hair, a serene expression, and is partially draped in flowing fabric. The robust, feathered wings spread widely behind the figure. In the background are clouds, lines, and the text "VIRTUTIS PRAEMIUM," with additional text and an artist's monogram in the lower left corner.
